item.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! (Thai Dub) - Episode 1 - Tips on How to Pass the Entrance Exam in Another World
item.description: Dennosuke Uchimura is an overlooked salaryman trying to climb the corporate ladder when he is unexpectedly summoned to interview in another world. Can the Demon Overlord’s hand picked candidate be hired as one of the four Elite Generals of his great army?

item.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! (Thai Dub) - Episode 2 - The Art of Negotiation in Captivating a Stubborn Tribal Chief
item.description: Hired as an Elite General, Dennosuke’s first task is to negotiate a merger with the leader of the resource starved Ogre Tribe. Despite their suffering and the Ogre leader's stubbornness, Dennosuke works to find a way forward for the Demon lord's army.

item.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! (Thai Dub) - Episode 3 - Now I Understand! Elite General Communication
item.description: Dennosuke now has the help of Olulu, the daughter of the leader of the ogre clan. This fact greatly annoys Ulmandra, who tries to get close to our protagonist with little success.

item.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! (Thai Dub) - Episode 4 - Breakthroughs Happen Even With Magic!
item.description: The Dark Lord gives Dennosuke a new task: to research the magical arts so that everyone can use magic even without the necessary power. And this time, he will have the help of the elusive Sylphid.

item.title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four! (Thai Dub) - Episode 5 - The Best Way to Enjoy a Stroll Through the Marketplace in Another World
item.description: Having done so much under the Overlord's direct orders, Dennosuke now feels he must step up his game by becoming proactive. He decides to make a bold move by researching the marketplace with Ulmandra, hoping to find a hint to make the army even greater.

item.title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions Season 2 (Thai Dub) - Episode 17 - The Case of the Midsummer Beachside Stand Drowning (Part 1)
item.description: Toto suggests that Ron take a rest. They invite Ron's doctor, Usaki Mofu, along and head for a dip in the ocean. Ron looks forward to having shaved ice with black sugar syrup from a beachside stand, but things soon take a tragic turn.
